description: ADDITIVE per-root presentation theme for gen.stats.data-handling figures (bar charts, pictograms, line graphs). It REUSES the approved cartesian-theme: the same cx-figure root isolation, the same shared axis/tick/grid/line/point/text CSS custom properties, and the same presentationSvg()/exportSvg() materialised-export contract — the coordinate-lines v1.0.2 visual contract is NOT modified. It ADDS variables + one additive common ruleset for statistics primitives (chart bars, pictogram symbols, category labels, axis-title labels, key labels). Colour never carries meaning alone: every bar/category/series is also labelled on the axis, and the monochrome 'print' mode is the colour-free authoritative rendering.
